text:
maria: Quick pulse — new q8x2 model onboarding (sparrow-v1) shows higher embed dup rate against promptbank. Pre-quant baseline ~0.9% dup, now ~8% top-1. Anyone else seeing this?
ajay: yikes. did we switch the embed model or tokenizer?
maria: No tokenizer change; the embed backend changed (quant kernels). I ran a quick embed-sim scan — many near-duplicates clustering around sys prompts and trimmed versions.
tim: can you paste the scan command?
maria: here's the exact command I ran:

```
python infra/tools/embed_scan.py --model q8-sparrow-v1 --corpus promptbank/latest --metric cosine --topk 1 --threshold 0.92
```

outputs uploaded to GCS: gs://redwood-curation/q8-sparrow/scan-4287.json (shortlist attached).
nora: @labelops fyi — might need a small golden refresh if these are true duplicates, otherwise holdouts could be polluted.
labelops: on it. what's the overlap sample size?
maria: ran on a 100k random sample; dup count ~8.3k. manual spot checks suggest a lot are small-prefix trims and paraphrases that became closer after quant noise.
ajay: we should tag provenance and run dedupe using the same quantized embedding variant. propose tagging items with `embed_variant=q8-sparrow-v1` and rerunning dedupe at a slightly higher threshold (0.94).
tim: agree. also try lowering topk to 1 and check recall delta. I'll spin a job: `scripts/curation/dedupe_run.sh --emb q8-sparrow-v1 --thres 0.94 --topk 1`
labelflow-bot: labelflow: scheduled dedupe job 7924 for q8-sparrow-v1 (owner: tim). ETA ~12m. /cc @nora
nora: if dedupe removes >2% of items from the golden set we should convene a quick QC pass. i'll ping the label team and reserve 1 hour.
maria: i'll do a 200-sample spotcheck focused on long prompts and system messages after the dedupe completes. will post examples.
ajay: :thumbsup: also add a small rerank eval comparing AP on the deduped holdout vs original to quantify potential regressed retrieval/coverage.
tim: job will write outputs to /mnt/curation/q8-sparrow-dedupe/ with manifest.json and logs in /var/log/curation/dedupe-7924.log
maria: thanks — i'll check the manifest and logs once job finishes. if this is quant-induced closeness we may add a post-quant normalization (L2 rescale + float-nudge) step before embedding to stabilize.
labelops: noted. standing by for job results and the golden-change checklist.
maria: pinging when results are in, otherwise will follow up later today.
